bottom_line: CSRD mandates detailed ESG reporting for large EU and non-EU companies; first filings due in 2025 for FY2024, with phased extension to smaller firms.
what_changed: European Financial Reporting Advisory Group published final European Sustainability Reporting Standards; first wave of companies must comply.
why_it_matters: Affects ~50,000 companies including non-EU firms with significant EU revenue; requires audited sustainability data, double materiality assessment.
affected_actors: non-EU companies with EU revenue above threshold
main_uncertainty: Third-country equivalence for non-EU standards not yet decided; assurance standards for sustainability data still developing.

scenarios.name: Rapid convergence
scenarios.description: CSRD becomes de facto global standard via supply chain pressure.

scenarios.name: Fragmented compliance
scenarios.description: Companies treat CSRD as box-ticking; data quality varies widely.
